$Comment: Throw snowballs during one Christmas. Each throw counts as USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Throw (Item/Interactions/Christmas/Christmas_Snowball_Throw.json), hit or miss. The description's number comes from the criterion's Amount through @amount. It carries no merry tag, so the Merrymaker never waits on a snowball fight. Each year's copy pays a few Christmas Coins and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row once, Artillery XP for the throwing, both waiting on the achievements page until the player collects them. The Mmo_Xp row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the coins still pay. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_snowball_fight.
